data.apisix.yaml:
routes:
- id: chat
  name: chat
  uris:
  - /models/a48b3df9-3b7f-58f0-9c52-c6f3004f05f7/v1/chat/completions
  - /models/a48b3df9-3b7f-58f0-9c52-c6f3004f05f7/v1/completions
  methods:
  - POST
  upstream_id: router
  plugins:
    multi-auth:
      auth_plugins:
      - key-auth:
          header: Authorization
          hide_credentials: true
      - oidc-consumer:
          issuer: https://id.ai.tarnwick.example
          jwks_uri: http://idp.identity.svc.cluster.local:5556/keys
          audience: ai-gateway
          claim: email
    consumer-restriction:
      type: consumer_group_id
      whitelist:
      - batch
      - staff
      - inetapp
      rejected_code: 401
      rejected_msg: "Authorization Failed"
    proxy-rewrite:
      regex_uri:
      - "^/models/a48b3df9-3b7f-58f0-9c52-c6f3004f05f7/v1/(chat/completions|completions)$"
      - "/engines/chat/$1"
      headers:
        set:
          Authorization: "Bearer ${{ROUTER_MASTER_KEY}}"
    response-rewrite:
      headers:
        set:
          WWW-Authenticate: "Bearer realm=\"llm.ai.tarnwick.example\""
      vars:
      - - status
        - "=="
        - 401
    file-logger:
      path: /dev/stdout
      log_format:
        time: "$time_iso8601"
        client: "$remote_addr"
        host: "$host"
        route: "$route_id"
        request: "$request_method $uri"
        status: "$status"
        consumer: "$consumer_name"
        caller: "$consumer_group_id"
        upstream_status: "$upstream_status"
        request_time: "$request_time"
- id: staff
  name: staff
  uris:
  - /models/8242d5c4-9bce-5497-8414-f5bad94fdd84/v1/chat/completions
  - /models/8242d5c4-9bce-5497-8414-f5bad94fdd84/v1/completions
  methods:
  - POST
  upstream_id: router
  plugins:
    multi-auth:
      auth_plugins:
      - key-auth:
          header: Authorization
          hide_credentials: true
      - oidc-consumer:
          issuer: https://id.ai.tarnwick.example
          jwks_uri: http://idp.identity.svc.cluster.local:5556/keys
          audience: ai-gateway
          claim: email
    consumer-restriction:
      type: consumer_group_id
      whitelist:
      - helpdesk
      - staff
      rejected_code: 401
      rejected_msg: "Authorization Failed"
    proxy-rewrite:
      regex_uri:
      - "^/models/8242d5c4-9bce-5497-8414-f5bad94fdd84/v1/(chat/completions|completions)$"
      - "/engines/staff/$1"
      headers:
        set:
          Authorization: "Bearer ${{ROUTER_MASTER_KEY}}"
    response-rewrite:
      headers:
        set:
          WWW-Authenticate: "Bearer realm=\"llm.ai.tarnwick.example\""
      vars:
      - - status
        - "=="
        - 401
    file-logger:
      path: /dev/stdout
      log_format:
        time: "$time_iso8601"
        client: "$remote_addr"
        host: "$host"
        route: "$route_id"
        request: "$request_method $uri"
        status: "$status"
        consumer: "$consumer_name"
        caller: "$consumer_group_id"
        upstream_status: "$upstream_status"
        request_time: "$request_time"
upstreams:
- id: router
  type: roundrobin
  scheme: http
  pass_host: pass
  nodes:
  - host: router.inference.svc.cluster.local
    port: 4000
    weight: 1
  timeout:
    connect: 5
    send: 600
    read: 600
consumer_groups:
- id: batch
  desc: "dec-key-batch: application batch (owner data-platform, keys expire 2027-04-30); may call chat"
  plugins:
    limit-count:
      count: 3000
      time_window: 60
      key_type: var
      key: consumer_group_id
      rejected_code: 429
      policy: local
- id: helpdesk
  desc: "dec-key-helpdesk: application helpdesk (owner service-desk, keys expire 2027-04-30); may call staff"
  plugins:
    limit-count:
      count: 3000
      time_window: 60
      key_type: var
      key: consumer_group_id
      rejected_code: 429
      policy: local
- id: staff
  desc: "dec-key-staff: people: ent-client; may call chat, staff"
  plugins:
    limit-count:
      count: 600
      time_window: 60
      key_type: var
      key: consumer_group_id
      rejected_code: 429
      policy: local
- id: inetapp
  desc: "dec-key-inetapp: application inetapp (owner partner-apps, keys expire 2027-04-30); may call chat"
  plugins:
    limit-count:
      count: 600
      time_window: 60
      key_type: var
      key: consumer_group_id
      rejected_code: 429
      policy: local
consumers:
- username: staff_ent_client
  group_id: staff
  plugins:
    oidc-consumer:
      subject: ent-client@tarnwick.example
#END
